## Design

### 2026-10-10 – I started working on the schematic for my starboy, and this is my second time using Kicad since a long time, so it took some research on how to use the symbols and wire everything. I started by findin

**3h**

I started working on the schematic for my starboy, and this is my second time using Kicad since a long time, so it took some research on how to use the symbols and wire everything. I started by finding and figuring out how to find the components, but once I watched an overview of how to do it, things started going smoothly until I met with another obstacle. I had no idea what net labels were or what to do with them, so I researched and learned about them. The pictures below are of my entire components and a close-up of the components.

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 001704](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/6228d1e80f7be0b2bd39c208151361744763d1c94f620973e2ba5ac8a226d27c.jpg)

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 001523](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/cafb81eecf76372aea0c55d5f39e6be687dc622bdaac05f9ee89dd6cfcf93d07.jpg)

This section surprisingly took a lot of time, as I am a complete beginner and more used to coding than hardware, so everything was new to me and I had to ask Google for a LOT of stuff.

### 2026-10-10 – I started working on the PCB for the starbie and came across many obstacles I realised mine looked different compared to the tutorial and realised I had to rotate the components. Then when creating th

**5h**

I started working on the PCB for the starbie and came across many obstacles I realised mine looked different compared to the tutorial and realised I had to rotate the components. Then when creating the outline I used line instead of polygon. Then during the wiring proccess (my longest obstacle) I had to re-do it 4 times. I also did re-do the GND zone. But what I accomplished during this session was: creating the PCB, routing everything, drawing the outline, and creating the zones.
